crossRefs.note: Behold, I set before you today a blessing and a curse:
the blessing, if you listen to the commandments of Yahweh your God, which I command you today;
You shall speak my words to them, whether they will hear, or whether they will refuse; for they are most rebellious.
“Son of man, I have made you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and warn them…
how I didn’t shrink from declaring to you anything that was profitable, teaching you publicly and from house to house,
Therefore I testify to you today that I am clean from the blood of all men,
for I didn’t shrink from declaring to you the whole counsel of God.
But they didn’t listen or turn their ear, but walked in their own counsels and in the stubbornness of their evil heart…
and it happen, when he hears the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, “I shall have peace…
But they refused to listen, and turned their backs, and stopped their ears, that they might not hear.
Yes, they made their hearts as hard as flint, lest they might hear the law, and the words which Yahweh of Armies had…

translations.web: I have declared it to you today; but you have not obeyed Yahweh your God’s voice in anything for which he has sent me to you.
translations.bsb: For I have told you today, but you have not obeyed the voice of the LORD your God in all He has sent me to tell you.
translations.kjv: And now I have this day declared it to you; but ye have not obeyed the voice of the LORD your God, nor any thing for the which he hath sent
translations.asv: and I have this day declared it to you; but ye have not obeyed the voice of Jehovah your God in anything for which he hath sent me unto you.
